messages:
Maya K: Hey panel — quick scheduling sync for candidate #542 (SDE IC3). Looking at two windows: Thu 2026-03-19 09:30-11:00 PST or Thu 2026-03-20 13:00-15:00 PST. Reply with whether you can make either, or give times you absolutely cannot. If you have pref order, add it.
Samir Patel: I can’t do the morning slot (conflict) but Thu 13:00-14:30 PST works for me.
Priya Chen: I’m out until 15:30 on Thu, so 13:00-14:30 is a no for me. Prefer anything after 15:30.
Jordan Rivera: Heads up — I’ll need to run a short debrief after the interview. Quick question on rubric: are we still using the 1-4 band per dimension (Technical / Design / Ownership / Communication)? Also, do we require everyone to attend the 15m sync or ok to leave notes if they can’t?
Alex Li: I can move things around and do Thu 14:00-15:00 PST if that helps. For debriefs I think 15m immediate + writeup in Greenhouse is the flow. Rubric: yes 1-4, and separate "recommendation" flag (yes/no).
Maya K: Ok tentative plan: Thu 14:00-15:00 PST seems to be the sweet spot if Alex + Samir agree and Priya can join asynchronously. I’ll hold off on invites for 10m and confirm. Debrief process: default = 15m immediate with hiring manager running; if you can’t make it, add notes + score in Greenhouse within 24h.
Priya Chen: Can someone drop a short debrief template here? I sometimes forget which prompts to hit during the 15m.
Maya K: Sure — quick template below (use in the debrief doc or paste into GH comments):
```
Summary: one-sentence summary of candidate
Strengths: bullet list
Concerns: bullet list
Scores (1-4):
  - Technical: 
  - System Design: 
  - Ownership: 
  - Communication: 
Recommendation: Yes / No / Hold
Notes for hiring manager: (if any)
```
Samir Patel: that looks good. One small rubric ask: when scoring Ownership, think about problem-scope and follow-through examples, not just past org size.
Jordan Rivera: Agreed. Also for System Design, if candidate lacks experience scale-wise, score the design reasoning more than the final architecture.
Alex Li: If we lock Thu 14:00-15:00 I'll block 15:15-15:30 for immediate debrief. If someone misses, we'll record the debrief notes in GH.
interview-bot: Calendar invites sent to confirmed panelists (Alex Li, Samir Patel, Maya K). Priya Chen: pending.
Maya K: Thanks — I’ll follow up in 15m with final invite and mark the debrief template in the interview packet. Ping me if you need to swap. :thumbsup:
